decisions.reasoning: AUDJPY.x has a directionally strong +0.517 12-bar move, equal to 2.59 ATR, with an aligned +0.070 six-bar change (0.35 ATR). The five bars from 19:00-23:00 consolidated between 109.233 and 109.478, and the latest 00:00 candle resumed higher to close 109.465 with a 109.512 high. Latest spread 0.004 is 0.80x the prior-12 median and 0.020 ATR, passing both liquidity limits. A BUY_STOP at 109.520 confirms above the latest/prior ceiling; stop 109.200 sits below the 109.216 pullback swing, and target 110.100 is below the older 110.165-110.285 resistance area, yielding an estimated 1.81R. Broad confirmation is present in positive 12-bar changes for USDJPY (+0.399), EURJPY (+0.424), GBPJPY (+0.788), CADJPY (+0.325), and CHFJPY (+0.767). GBPCAD is rejected despite a marginal breakout because its spread is 0.184 ATR, above the 0.15 cap. Score 9/10: structure 2, momentum 2, entry 2, spread/liquidity 1, reward/risk 2, cross-market/exposure 0 because actual JPY exposure is unverified.
